item: UCDP GED and Candidate event parser with fatality ranges (S08-01 S1)
summary: Pure parser of UCDP's georeferenced event rows from the keyless versioned download CSV or an API page (same field names; R747). The caller names dataset and version: GED is final, Candidate preliminary. Fatalities are a low/best/high range with no single-number accessor; a missing bound stays a gap, an out-of-order range is kept and flagged. No coordinates = an event with no map point; off-globe coordinates dropped, bad dates keep raw text, unknown violence type keeps its code, rows without id or with a repeated id skipped and counted. No network, schema, store or re-extraction. R747 recorded; the S08-01 brief's stale Q823 lines corrected. Remains: store, consent-gated fetch after the operator probes, map/agenda/dossier rails.
